**Visual analysis:**

- Sugarcane leaf laid flat, showing a prominent white/cream longitudinal stripe running parallel to the veins along the central portion of the leaf
- Green tissue flanks both sides of the stripe
- A reddish-brown discoloration is visible within the white stripe in the lower section
- No mosaic/mottling patterns, no bushy/grassy morphology, no twisted leaves

**Matching to classes:**

- **Leaf_Scald** matches directly: "white pencil line (1-2 mm wide) extending from midrib to leaf margin parallel to veins, reddish discoloration along the pencil line." The white stripe with the reddish lesion spot is the hallmark symptom.
- Streak_Mosaic/Mosaic_Virus would show multiple irregular streaks or mosaic patterns — not a single clean white line.
- Yellow_Leaf would show yellowing of midribs, not a distinct white pencil-line stripe.
